contains.app: 1.8.39: Calendar, Board and Plan are vector view models built from the atlas (Exp7VM), with view options, a default skin and per-app tokens; the HTML view builders and the HTML layout path for these views are removed. 1.8.38: the Calendar selection counter follows the selection (it stayed at "0 day(s) selected"). 1.8.37: JRender with an indexed draw-list core (scroll, patch, hover and load no longer walk the whole scene; growth uploads only changed vertices) and a 4 ms frame budget for off-screen tessellation, so on-screen rows are drawn live and the margin catches up. 1.8.36: The parallax holds still while a view scrolls and resumes 160 ms after the last scroll, with no jump; edges redraw only when their drawn offset changes, and frames with nothing to change send no patch and draw nothing extra. 1.8.35: Board scrolling and layout scale with what is on screen: parallax moves only slabs within a screen of the viewport, in 1/8 px steps, and the state-layer layout pass (roomBelow, ground-shadow ids) is linear instead of quadratic, with identical layout output. Board category-name fields are created only for rows near the viewport and added as you scroll. 1.8.34: The old ranking code is gone: no Exp6 JGroup.Best()/SimulatedBest() ranking, fallback or inline kernel copies; JAtlasModel.exp6Order is now rankAlts and JFEngine (Exp7Rank) is the only ranking path. Picks, orders and scores are unchanged. 1.8.33: Exp7 ranks alternatives with JFEngine (Lore jeditor r29) instead of Exp6 JGroup.Best()/SimulatedBest(): each group scores as one batch (jfactor terms through the Exp6 kernel via JFEngine) and ranks by score, highest first, ties in list order, giving the same order as Best() on every shipped group. jfactor() now uses the real Exp6 kernel (method 2). 1.8.32: The Path inspector on the Atlas, Proposal console and Two writers tabs lists the paths the last proposal touched plus a 20-path preview; the full match list is built only while you search it (up to 200), and the Paths tab still lists everything. Opening those tabs no longer lays out all 1,192 rows. 1.8.31: Board values show as the value with its unit, red when consuming and green when not. An item's other buttons sit on a line under it, and item lists start hidden. The Budget date is one button that opens a mini calendar over the view. Board rows move with the pointer again.
